text:
[LUNI.3.1.4] **Adjacency commits to a unit, never to multiplication.**
A numeric literal directly adjacent to a letter token **is** a unit
literal: `30x` is thirty of a unit named `x`, and if no such unit is
declared it is an unknown-unit error — not `30 * x`.

The reading does not compete with an arithmetic one: an author who means multiplication
writes the operator. The diagnostic for an unknown unit should
nevertheless say so, because the mistake is easy to make and the fix
is a single character.
